draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Swaraj Round! This roughly 2 km ring road circles the 65-acre Thekkinkadu Maidan, with the Vadakkunnathan Temple to Shiva on the hillock in the middle. It's one of the biggest roundabouts in South Asia, fed by seventeen roads.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't cover Thrissur's eateries, so follow the crowds along the Round, it's the city's busiest shopping strip.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Thekkinkadu Maidan is a 5 min walk, Shakthan Thampuran Palace about 7 min, and Jos Theatre, Kerala's first permanent cinema, about 9 min.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Wander onto Thekkinkadu Maidan, the big open ground around the temple, and slow down for a bit.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Basilica of Our Lady of Dolours here has the Bible tower, 79 metres high and called the tallest church tower in Asia.

spots.name: Jos Theatre
spots.detail: 9 min walk · Kerala's first permanent cinema

legends.title: Feeding the elephants
legends.body: On the first day of Karkkidakam, around July, the temple holds Aanayoottu, a feast for elephants. It's a festival all of its own.

tips.title: Come for Pooram in April or May.
tips.body: Thrissur Pooram brings caparisoned elephants, parasol exchanges and midnight fireworks, all visible from the streets.

tips.title: Bring your passport for Pooram.
tips.body: Tourists can sometimes get free guest platform tickets at the tourist office, about 10 minutes north of the temple.

story.title: A meeting point
story.body: Thrissur, once called Thrissivaperur, was a point of contact for Assyrians, Greeks, Persians, Arabs and Romans, and later the Portuguese, Dutch and English. It was once the capital of the Kingdom of Cochin.

story.title: Sakthan Thampuran
story.body: Ramavarma Thampuran, known as Sakthan Thampuran, rebuilt his palace in Kerala-Dutch style in 1795 and built the Vadakkechira pond. He also split the temples into Paramekkavu and Thiruvambady sides for Thrissur Pooram.

story.title: Old schools
story.body: The Government Model school for boys opened in 1836, the oldest in the district, and CMS missionaries started their school right by the Round in 1845.

story.title: Puthen Palli
story.body: The Basilica of Our Lady of Dolours was built in 1875, and locals call it Puthen Palli. Its huge interior is covered in murals.

story.title: City of Celebrations
story.body: Thrissur is called the cultural capital of Kerala, with its arts academies around the city centre. Walk the Round and tell me which spot you liked best.
